/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Delaware
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: Are eviction cases first heard in housing court?
*/

/* =========================
   Scenario (facts)
   ========================= */

state(delaware).
focus_year(2021).

% The question scenario we are asked to evaluate.
question_presented(eviction_cases_first_heard_in_housing_court).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the encoded factual statement holds.
scenario_statement :-
    state(delaware),
    focus_year(2021),
    question_presented(eviction_cases_first_heard_in_housing_court).


/* =========================
   Statutes (translated)
   Only statute text provided is 29 Del. C.  5701 (2021), which is not a
   landlord-tenant / eviction-court jurisdiction statute.
   ========================= */

% ---- Statute metadata / topical mapping (used for relevance reasoning) ----

% statute_in_force(StatuteId, State, Year).
statute_in_force(delaware_29_del_c_5701_2021, delaware, 2021).

% statute_mentions_topic(StatuteId, Topic).
% 29 Del. C.  5701 concerns definitions for state Social Security coverage / employment concepts.
statute_mentions_topic(delaware_29_del_c_5701_2021, employment_definitions).
statute_mentions_topic(delaware_29_del_c_5701_2021, social_security_coverage).
statute_mentions_topic(delaware_29_del_c_5701_2021, fica_definition).
statute_mentions_topic(delaware_29_del_c_5701_2021, wages_definition).
statute_mentions_topic(delaware_29_del_c_5701_2021, political_subdivisions_definition).
statute_mentions_topic(delaware_29_del_c_5701_2021, state_agency_definition).

% No provided statute mentions eviction procedure, housing court, or court jurisdiction.
% (Intentionally no fact like statute_mentions_topic(..., eviction_housing_court_jurisdiction).)


/* ---- 29 Del. C.  5701 (2021): Definitions (deterministic predicates) ----
   These predicates encode the *meaning* of the statutory definitions in a reusable way.
*/

%  5701(1): "Employee" includes an officer of a state or political subdivision thereof.
statute_5701_employee(Person) :-
    officer_of_state_or_political_subdivision(Person),
    !.
statute_5701_employee(Person) :-
    nonofficer_employee_in_covered_employment(Person),
    !.

% Helper predicates representing the kinds of facts that could exist in a case.
% (No concrete persons are asserted in this scenario; these exist to make the statute encoding complete.)
officer_of_state_or_political_subdivision(_Person) :- fail.
nonofficer_employee_in_covered_employment(_Person) :- fail.

%  5701(2): "Employment" means service performed by an employee in the employ of the State,
% local government, housing authority or any other political subdivision, subject to exclusions and certifications.
statute_5701_employment(Service) :-
    service_performed_by_employee(Service, Emp),
    statute_5701_employee(Emp),
    service_in_employ_of_covered_employer(Service),
    \+ statute_5701_employment_excluded(Service),
    !.
statute_5701_employment(Service) :-
    service_includable_only_upon_governor_certification(Service),
    governor_issues_certificate_for_service(Service),
    !.

% Covered employer types per  5701(2).
service_in_employ_of_covered_employer(Service) :-
    employ_of(Service, Employer),
    covered_employer(Employer),
    !.

covered_employer(state_of_delaware) :- !.
covered_employer(local_government) :- !.
covered_employer(housing_authority) :- !.
covered_employer(political_subdivision) :- !.

% Exclusions per  5701(2)(i)-(ii).
statute_5701_employment_excluded(Service) :-
    excluded_under_ssa_absent_agreement(Service),
    !.
statute_5701_employment_excluded(Service) :-
    not_includable_under_ssa_agreement(Service),
    !.

% Placeholders for SSA-related determinations (none asserted here).
excluded_under_ssa_absent_agreement(_Service) :- fail.
not_includable_under_ssa_agreement(_Service) :- fail.
service_includable_only_upon_governor_certification(_Service) :- fail.
governor_issues_certificate_for_service(_Service) :- fail.

% Minimal service relation placeholders.
service_performed_by_employee(_Service, _Employee) :- fail.
employ_of(_Service, _Employer) :- fail.

%  5701(3): "Federal Insurance Contributions Act" meaning; "employee tax" meaning.
statute_5701_fica_means(fica_1939_subchapter_a_chapter_9_and_1954_subchapters_a_b_chapter_21) :- !.
statute_5701_employee_tax_means(tax_imposed_by_1939_code_1400_and_1954_code_3101) :- !.

%  5701(5): "Political subdivisions" includes certain instrumentalities; housing authority is a political subdivision.
statute_5701_political_subdivision_includes(housing_authority_continued_under_31_title_chapter_43) :- !.

%  5701(8): "State Agency" means the State Treasurer.
statute_5701_state_agency(state_treasurer) :- !.

%  5701(9): "Wages" means all remuneration for employment (as defined), with an exception.
statute_5701_wages(Remuneration) :-
    remuneration_for_employment(Remuneration, Service),
    statute_5701_employment(Service),
    \+ excluded_from_wages_even_if_fica_wages(Remuneration),
    !.

% Placeholders for remuneration facts.
remuneration_for_employment(_Remuneration, _Service) :- fail.
excluded_from_wages_even_if_fica_wages(_Remuneration) :- fail.


/* =========================
   Legal reasoning: eviction first-hearing forum
   ========================= */

% We answer "yes" only if some in-force provided statute supplies the topic:
% "eviction cases are first heard in housing court" (i.e., housing court has initial/original forum).
legal_eviction_cases_first_heard_in_housing_court(State, Year) :-
    statute_in_force(StatuteId, State, Year),
    statute_mentions_topic(StatuteId, eviction_housing_court_jurisdiction),
    !.

% Apply the law to the scenario.
housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    state(State),
    focus_year(Year),
    legal_eviction_cases_first_heard_in_housing_court(State, Year),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).
